method: offline Unicorn runs of the original slot-3 entries over the memory image with synthetic grid resources, capsules, profiles and poisoned output buffers; return value and every output byte (including untouched tail) compared with engine.pose_narrowphase_capsule_grid under the emulator two-NaN rule; executed addresses must stay inside the contact-code region and the stack probe
bug_injections: edge-plane threshold 0 instead of 1e-5 fails at case 4
same-side core ignores its capacity argument fails at case 32
no world transform of kept records fails at case 2
(4,7) wrapper without 0x1994f60 flip fails at case 2
pierce test always false (edge path only) fails at case 7
crossing core never called fails at case 6
degenerate-normal fallback uses -n instead of the plane normal fails at case 11
closest-pair search starts at 0 instead of FLT_MAX fails at case 1
preliminary centre scaled by 1 instead of 0.5 fails at case 5
same-side normal not oriented by d0 + d1 fails at case 20
supplied: 0x18c9140 allocation (returns a scratch buffer; requested size checked) and 0x18c8f50 free (pointer checked) on the candidate-retry path only
supplied_state: runtime XYZ mask 0x3336890 = {-1,-1,-1,0} (zero in the image)
TEB StackLimit at gs:[0x10] for __chkstk; TLS slot array, index 0x333c630 = 0, epoch 0x7fffffff (no guarded static is read on these paths)
statics 0x3336a30/50/70 = 1e-7 x4 with guards = 1 (not read on these paths)
limits: synthetic grids (1..14 cells per side), uneven/sloped/flat samples, synthetic profiles

grid helpers (enumeration, height query, vertices, filter, profile gate) are float models; entry cases keep frames, samples and capsule sizes finite; NaN/inf/subnormal lanes are exercised in the direct core cases and in the masked fourth lanes of the geom rows
MXCSR 0x1f80; hardware two-NaN behaviour not observed; no live game, no original-engine equivalence
